requestStages.attribution: Reported prepare, forward, and total timings use architecture-specific performance.now() boundaries in milliseconds. Residuals are computed per sample: postForwardResidualMs = reportedTotalMs - reportedPrepareMs - reportedForwardMs; outerResidualMs = wallMs - reportedTotalMs. Residuals cover work between timers, including CPU work, copies, and GPU waits; they are not pure CPU time.
